// Fixture de l'auto-test de check_selection_single_mutator.cmake : AUCUNE violation.
// Prose : selectedObject_ = x; multiSelection_.clear(); (ignore, commentaire)
struct W {
    std::optional<ObjectId> selectedObject_;
    std::vector<ObjectId> multiSelection_;
    std::optional<RegionId> selectedRegion_;
    std::optional<ObjectId> selectedEmbroidery_;
};

// SELECTION-MUTATOR:BEGIN
void W::setSelection(Selection s) {
    selectedRegion_ = s.region;
    selectedEmbroidery_ = s.embroidery;
    selectedObject_.reset();
    multiSelection_.clear();
    multiSelection_.push_back(s.id);
    std::sort(multiSelection_.begin(), multiSelection_.end());
}
// SELECTION-MUTATOR:END
